text: the undo history just resets the brush color to white but does not revert the last change
resolution: Two paint-persistence bugs. (1) Ctrl-Z reset the brush colour to white but didn't revert the stroke — paint lives in the GPU texture outside studioModel's undoable event stream, so model.undo() only reverted a stray palette mint. Added a paint-only snapshot ring (readback the texture before each stroke; undo restores the prior state, redo re-applies); the parent Ctrl-Z/Y prefers paint undo/redo while paint mode is active, else falls through to model history. (2) paint->object->paint wiped everything because the <Paintable> was gated on paint mode, so leaving paint unmounted it and destroyed the GPU texture; it now stays mounted whenever a paint texture exists (the mesh still only samples it in paint mode), and restore/base-coat runs only once per model per session so re-entering paint no longer re-coats over the live texture.
